verdict.rationale: Veriff provides signed decision and event webhooks (HMAC signature headers) covering decision outcomes and progress events, and also polling as a secondary option, but the evidence doesn't explicitly enumerate all lifecycle states like 'created', 'processing', 'requires-input' as distinct webhook event types. missing for 10: explicit documentation of each named lifecycle state (created/processing/requires-input) as webhook payload values, independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook reliability and signature verification in practice.
